name: Taper candle
description: A thin wax taper. It burns down quickly and needs a flame to light.
notes: CHECK MASS (x3.75): the reference gives 4 g, but a 15 cm taper 13 mm across holds about 15 g of wax, so the mass follows the shape. Lighting, like the base candle, belongs on a light block when it is applied.

name: Pocket dive light
description: A small sealed flashlight in an aluminium tube, made to work underwater. Runs on batteries and clips onto some dive masks and hoods.
notes: A battery beam like the base flashlight, but shorter range.

name: Bright pocket dive light
description: A small sealed flashlight with a steel bezel and a high-output bulb that drains its batteries quickly.
notes: Shares the pocket dive light's model; the steel bezel and bare tube tell it apart. Its mass is 40 g against 48 g for the plain light, as the reference gives.

name: Adjustable dive light
description: A chunky waterproof flashlight with a twist collar that sets its brightness. A lug underneath takes a wrist strap or a mask clip.
notes: Its brightness steps would need a light with several levels, which no light has yet.

name: Battery lantern
description: A battery camping lantern with a frosted shade and a carry handle. It casts a dim light all round and runs for days on one set of batteries.
notes: An all-round light rather than a beam; it can be set down and left lit.

name: Pressure lantern
description: A small lantern that burns pumped gasoline behind a glass globe. It gives a steady light for hours on a full fount.
notes: Fuel would ride on a fuel-fill port like the oil lamp in lights.libsonnet; the row is a single compound. The globe is see-through in the game; tiles draw it opaque.

name: Propane lantern
description: A lantern head with a glass globe that screws onto a small propane cylinder. It burns for hours on one cylinder.
notes: Modelled without its cylinder, which would be its own item. The reference mass of 1.4 kg is kept though a bare head weighs less; it suits a head with a cylinder fitted. The globe is see-through in the game.

name: Road flare
description: A paper tube of magnesium compound with a striker under its cap. Once struck it burns bright red for about half an hour and cannot be put out.
notes: Single-use burning light; the burn-down would belong on its light block when it is applied.

name: Right-angle flashlight
description: A tough polymer flashlight with its lens on the front face and a spring clip on the back to hang it from a coat strap. Sealed against water and gas.
notes: The reference row is the switched-on state; the off state shares the model, and its lens takes a plain finish when it is applied. Clipped to a coat it would want a chest attach point, which no host offers yet.

name: LED strip
description: About eight metres of stick-on LED tape wound on a reel, with a plug on the loose end. Needs a power source.
notes: The lit state rides on the same model.

name: Menorah
description: A nine-branched silver-coloured candleholder for the Jewish festival of Hanukkah. Eight cups sit in a row with a ninth raised in the middle.
notes: Holds candles; it gives no light of its own. The reference lists steel, drawn here in a silver finish as most are plated.

name: Clay oil lamp
description: A small fired-clay lamp with a wick in its spout and a hole on top for oil. The open flame goes out in wind.
notes: A craftable light; the wind rule would need the light block to douse outdoors.

name: Acetylene lamp
description: An old brass lamp that burns acetylene in front of a polished reflector. Bright and economical, and the gas is explosive.
notes: Drawn as a brass miner's lamp with its own gas chamber; the reference's copper is brass here.

name: Clip-on book light
description: A small battery LED on a bendable neck with a spring clip to fix it to a book or shelf.
notes: The lit state rides on the same model. Light enough to read by and little else.

name: Smart table lamp
description: A white table lamp with a mushroom shade, switched from a phone or by voice. Its circuit board and LEDs can be salvaged.
notes: Runs on mains power in its world; as a carried item it is salvage. Its white shade reads grey in the tiles because `plastic-gloss-white` is lit flat.
